run_single_point_orca: run a single-point DFT energy calculation using ORCA with a specified functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run an ORCA geometry optimization (relaxation) job with configurable optimizer parameters and step counter
run_orca_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point or optimization calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled
run_orca_metal_organics: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using UKS
run_orca_parallel: run an ORCA calculation parallelized across a specified number of CPU processes
